<!-- real-test v1 sha=e45cbbe099fb5a28845c6067fd0e9a29d6d5cdc5 verdict=MERGEABLE-CON-GAP -->
**Real test, 2026-10-18**

ambiente: api-staging.example.com serving the branch + preview https://acme-web-j3nzevujw.vercel.app (marker `ad76031ae`), migration `20261018100000` applied on staging by `supabase-migrations-staging.yml` (run 39143361455); two fresh-context Opus breakers on a dedicated headless Chrome (profile-1719, first `list_tabs()` about:blank only), account qa@example.com, nothing validated; local repro on the worktree (backend 8018 on the staging DB + Vite) between the two
sha servito: ad76031aed946afba9696f70685b738edcb332d9

`/health` commit and preview marker both `ad76031ae`; e45cbbe09 adds only `.real-test/evidence/` files.

osservato: breaker 1 on 3c30a81e3, full contract: PDF heading for azienda, privato and condominio; A→B and a name over a linked quote never print A's data; photograph kept after a card edit, «Completa» re-photographs; homonyms; client-error 204/422/401; P.IVA copy; phone 390×844 without horizontal scroll. Its defects were fixed red→green in ad76031ae: «Completo» 5 s late (now 74 ms after the PUT), «Annulla» needing two clicks with the list open (editor and PDF dialog), the condominio amministratore unreachable once linked (picking the same committente re-photographs). Breaker 2 on ad76031ae: those three pass on staging, A→B and homonyms still pass. Evidence in `.real-test/evidence/1942-ad76031ae/` and `1942-locale-fix/`.
rami: heading lines (provincia, missing C.F./P.IVA/indirizzo, condominio with and without «c.a.»); `_righe_intestazione` with a stale snapshot under another name; Enter with one, two or no exact names; blur by press (held until the click) and by Tab (at once); same committente picked again; 5xx download text never shown (unit, msw); client-error codes and limits; Italian day of the title.

**Gap:** on staging, during 502s and 6–10 s responses, the first PDF right after picking the same committente again once printed the old photograph (1 of 2; the second passed). The mechanism is deterministic on the branch backend: 5 of 5 cycles «card edit → same pick → immediate GET» return the new heading, and the PDF reads that field. Error branches of `ritorno.ts` and `quote_committente.py:126` are covered by unit tests only.
